item.description: GUWAHATI: India’s leading stock exchanges, the National Stock Exchange (NSE) and Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) announced on Friday that equity markets will remain open for live trading on Sunday, February 1, the day the Union Budget 2026 is presented by Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman. item.title: Vande Bharat Sleeper Express to Begin Regular Kamakhya–Howrah Services from January 22
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Vande Bharat Sleeper Express operating between Kamakhya and Howrah will commence its regular services from January 22, following its inauguration by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Saturday, January 17. The train will run six days a week, enhancing overnight rail connectivity between Assam and West Bengal. item.title: DGCA Fines Indigo ₹22.20 Crore Over December Flight Disruptions
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) has imposed a penalty of Rs 22.20 crore on IndiGo Airlines for large-scale flight disruptions in early December 2025 that affected over three lakh passengers.
